# Reporting a security problem

If you found a way Unpause could leak your data, run something it should not, accept a tampered update or download, or
expose a password or key, please **do not open a public issue**. Report it privately instead:

- Use **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/GigaRho/unpause-feedback/security/advisories/new)** on this repository (the Security tab). Only the
  maintainers see it.

Tell us the Unpause version (Settings › Updates shows it), your system, and the steps to reproduce. We answer within a week,
work on a fix with you, and credit you in the patch notes unless you would rather stay anonymous. Please give us a fair
chance to ship the fix before you talk about it in public.

Supported versions: the newest release on each update channel. Fixes ship as a new version through Settings › Updates.
